description: This file contains unit tests for the tenantClient utility functions, including functions like normalizeTenantId, fetchSessionTenants, selectTenant, and setActiveTenant.

methods.name: normalizeTenantId
methods.description: Normalizes different tenant ID object structures or strings to a string ID.

methods.description: Stores the active tenant ID in localStorage, removing legacy keys.
